description: Configures or updates a Helix Ultimate Mega Menu layout for a specific menu item ID. Enforces Bootstrap 12-column grid rule per row and syncs with MySQL.

enabled.description: Whether mega menu dropdown is enabled (true/false)

menuItemId.description: Joomla menu item ID to configure (e.g. "101")

rows.description: Array of rows for the mega menu grid layout. Each row contains columns whose colGrid values must sum to 12.

items.description: Array of child menu items or modules in this column

moduleId.description: Optional Joomla module ID rendered in this column

template.description: Optional template folder name. Defaults to active Helix template.

name: helix_update_megamenu
